dead-letter:broker.title: jobs queue has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:broker.message: If Worker 1, Worker 2 and 1 more can't handle a message, it's dropped after 3 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:broker.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.
